thread:
jess (PM): FYI customer BetaCorp says they will only pilot if we provide "team controls" and a basic audit export. Need quick decision whether to delay MVP or ship pilot-light.

omar (ENG): Full RBAC is several sprints. We can do a pilot-light: IdP groups -> team mapping, two roles (admin/member), HMAC-signed event log export. Feature-flagged per tenant. ~5 engineer-days.

nina (UX): Minimal modal for mapping + a clear "Pilot limits" callout in onboarding. Won't block.

lee (SRE): S3 export + retention default 30d is fine for pilot. Will add runbook and health checks.

phil (AE): BetaCorp will sign pilot if we commit to full RBAC within 60 days. They need acceptance tests (Okta/AD).

jess (PM): Decision: ship MVP on time with pilot-light gated by feature flag and commit to v1 RBAC in 60 days. ACs: mapping modal, role enforcement, signed exports, per-tenant flag. Approve?

omar (ENG): +1. We'll gate with canary on Dedicated and avoid public roll.

nina (UX): +1. I'll add banner copy and demo screens.

lee (SRE): +1. I'll create export bucket template and alerts.

phil (AE): +1. I'll get verbal sign and push legal for amendment.

deploy-bot: deploy 1987654400 to staging/product -- success :rocket:

jess (PM): Action items: jess -> draft amendment; omar -> pilot adapter PR in 5 days; nina -> banner/modal in 3 days; lee -> export/runbook in 4 days; phil -> legal/contract follow-up EOD.

phil (AE): verbal sign received. Legal wants the 60-day window in writing. Circulating now.

omar (ENG): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pilot-access/pull/21 (draft). Feature-flagged, Okta tests added.

jess (PM): Closing: MVP ships on time; BetaCorp pilot uses pilot-light controls; full RBAC targeted within 60 days. Keep updates here.
